items.title: Klaas de Keepfluencer filmt alles: 'Als je dit wilt doen, moet je schijt hebben'
items.summary: Naast zijn rol als doelman van Flevo Boys timmert Klaas Boersma aan de weg als 'Keepfluencer'. Met een GoPro in zijn doel laat de 31-jarige sluitpost zijn volgers alles zien. 'Maar ik zei meteen gekscherend tegen mijn vriendin: ik denk dat deze video goed gaat presteren.'

items.title: James McClean: ‘Wearing the poppy was just never going to happen’
items.summary: The former Republic of Ireland international on growing up in a community still reeling from the Troubles and the controversy that scarred his career “The perception of me is that, basically, I am a madman,” James McClean says calmly. “I’m outspoken. I’m a loudmouth. I’m very opinionated and I hate all things British. That’s from people who don’t know me. The reality is quite the opposite. I’m pretty boring. I go training, go home and switch off. A lot of my days are quite bland, quite basic.” McClean sounds as sane as he looks gaunt on a bleak Monday in Derry. He spent 14 years in English football and the fact that he is now at war with his own club, Derry City, can’t obscure the fact that he is the fifth-most-capped Republic of Ireland international, having played 103 times. “People define success in different ways,” he says, “but I’m the only footballer from the north of Ireland to win over 100 caps for Ireland. I played 150 Premier League games over five seasons, 800 professional games and won a lot of individual accolades. I count that as success and don’t look back with regrets.” Continue reading...

items.title: Wolves extend Burnley’s home woes to a full year as Vardy strikes in vain
